storage: NONE since 2026-11-06: the file is read in memory each poll (it carries its own daily history, 2011-05-02 onward) and its rows are dropped. Only a derived summary is written, <DATA_DIR>/voltrade_squeeze_gex_summary.json (latest date, row count, trailing-252 rank, GEX sign, fetch time; no SqueezeMetrics value). The 2026-10-29..11-06 archive under <archive>/squeeze_gex/ is deleted at boot (once, audit row SQUEEZE-ARCHIVE-REMOVED).
written_by: server/squeezeGex.ts refreshSqueezeGex (6h poll, eager boot) - the derived summary only
source: squeezemetrics.com/monitor/static/DIX.csv — keyless CSV (date,price,dix,gex), probed live 2026-10-29 (last row 2026-10-28) and 2026-11-06 (3,903 rows, 2011-05-02..2026-11-05). GEX is a proprietary MODEL ESTIMATE (dealers assumed long calls / short puts), SPX $ gamma per 1% move.
license: UNVERIFIED. SqueezeMetrics' Terms of Service bar compiling their data into a collection or database without written permission (research/wishlist.md 2026-11-06; permission requested), so nothing of it is stored and it is never redistributed on /data, /api/v1 or the streams inventory (peek withheld).

field_map.asOf: the file's latest row: the SPX session its values describe
field_map.rank252: trailing-252 percentile rank of the latest GEX (registered Edge P1 definition); null under 252 rows
field_map.gexNegative: sign of the latest GEX (the value itself is not kept)
field_map.fetchedAt: ISO time the file was read

confidence_model: Gate 2 PASS (research/edge_p1_dealer_gamma_result.md, b=-0.858 t=-9.61; holdout t=-7.25). Gate 1 OPEN: our own Black-Scholes GEX from Alpaca OI is not yet comparable (scripts/edge_p1_gate1.py, which reads the live file's history). Read by the dealer-gamma short-premium filter (dealer_gamma.py, 2026-11-06) through the derived summary.
cadence: daily source, published after the close; 6h poll
peek_reason: SqueezeMetrics' terms: their values are not redistributed
_note: Universal archive envelope, kept for a stream that is read but not archived. Edge P1 shadow-logging stream registered in research/edge_preregistration.md. Archiving returns only with SqueezeMetrics' written permission (server/squeezeGex.ts header).
